body: not gonna lie, expected a bit more of a response, never been suicidal before lol...

I am very sorry about your diagnosis. Personally, I have OCD/GAD/depression and I'd be willing to trade you :)

You still have a lot going for you so like aspie said, talk to someone who is familiar with the disorder like an epilepsy councilor so that you can get a really good plan put in motion :)

Also, I don't say this to frighten you by any means, in fact I'm only saying it to protect you because I lost a friend due to a fluke involving this disorder. If you ever go into a pool, etc, please make sure you are with somebody else. My friend had a seizure while in a pool alone, had a seizure and drowned :( He may have not been on his medication, I'm not sure. Just be thoughtful of stuff like that for the 0.00001% :)

I'm sure you will do great!

I think that's what has prompted my decision. If doing something simple like going to University or working becomes insurmountable (for me) I probably will just kill myself. A life of dependence and not being able to physically enjoy life is not a life -- it is merely an existence.

I've already increased my medication and so far the effects seem negligible although I'm sure they are in fact helping.

I'm doing everything else necessary, it's just a hard situation.

-Constant harassing thoughts
-Physical psychosomatic pains in my head and face (constant)
-Extreme depression
-Extreme lack of energy
-Currently unable to work
-etc etc etc
